This is the GP interest: 4.0125% economic. R-01 does not apply, so it is paid gross."}],"notes":"WF3 for D-002 (Atlas Growth Fund I, notice DOC-0202), prepared up to step 9. It still needs second review and sign-off (step 10, control C3.5). The database is read-only, so I have not opened a distribution case or written any withholding determination or schedule rows. Nothing has been recorded yet.

DISTRIBUTION: record date 2026-12-15, payment date 2027-01-12, USD 8,000,000. There is one component, D-002-A: a US-source dividend from Orion Manufacturing (P-009), paid through Atlas Acquisition SPV (P-010). It is subject to withholding on foreign persons (R-01; FR-01 met).

RECONCILIATION (C3.4): the 12 payee lines add up to 8,000,000 and match unit_pct at the record date. Totals: gross 8,000,000; tax 1,125,900; net 6,874,100. The schedule names the party whose income it is, so the two intermediaries are looked through:
- Payee CP-102 (feeder I-002): gross 1,920,000; tax 384,000; net 1,536,000.
- Payee CP-107 (Sterling I-007): gross 480,000; tax 144,000; net 336,000.

FOR THE REVIEWER:
1. RULE VERSION: I used R-02 v2027.1 at 10% (2026 Protocol, AU-03, marked "illustrative") because payment falls after 2027-01-01. R-02 v2026.1 (15%) has no eff_to, so the two versions overlap in the rulebook. Please confirm the protocol is in force for payments on 2027-01-12. If it is not, the R-02 lines (I-001, I-010, I-004, I-005, I-008) go to 15%, which adds 154,950 of tax. R-03 has only v2026.1 and no protocol version, so please confirm the 5% still stands.
2. I-003 AT 5% (R-03): the effective vote of 10.00% (12.5% x 80%) is exactly at the threshold. It also assumes we look through the fund and the SPV. Please confirm. I-004, at 9.99%, does not qualify.
3. I-011 MOSELLE: the move to Belgium (DOC-0111) means F-011 and its LU claim are no longer valid. No change case is open against CL-002. One needs to be opened (WF2), and CL-002's reliance on F-011 must be revisited.
4. I-013 ECHTERNACH: form F-013 ends 2026-12-31, before the payment date (step 5, control C3.2). It can be cured, so pass it to WF2 with a 2027-01-12 deadline. The 30% in the schedule is provisional; if the form is renewed in time, it becomes 10% (tax drops by 60,000). The register also doesn't match the documents: F-013 is recorded as signed 2023-03-06, but the DOC-0107 statement says W-8BEN-E dated 4 March 2025.
5. I-006 MERIDIAN: change case K-006 is still open. The circular Meridian I/II holding comes back to the Jersey trust owning 100%, but whether the ownership-based limitation-on-benefits claim still holds is for K-006 to decide. Defaulted at 30% for now; it can be redetermined if the case closes before payment.
6. DEFAULT VS HOLD: the fund LPA (DOC-0001) is not digitised, so I could not check whether holds are allowed. All uncured lines are on the default rate instead. Investor relations must notify I-011, I-006, I-013/I-014 (through Sterling) and I-015 before payment, with the item each needs to cure (control C3.7).
7. DATA CHECKS:
- I-016's holding in entity_mgmt (H-006) is 3.5%, but the register and distribution lines use 3%. I used 3%.
- I-008 and I-009 are both named "Alpha Holdings SA". I matched them by LEI and reg no.
- Several records (DOC-0202, DOC-0111, I-011 residence recorded 2026-12-20, P-009/P-010) are dated after the system date of 2026-10-14. Please confirm the as-of date the schedule is prepared on."}
